comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Culture and Engagement Survey Results
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD conducts annual global workforce surveys to measure culture and engagement; the 2024 survey results were among the best for global tech companies, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative and engagement ratings in the top 10% of peers.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and AMD utilize annual employee surveys to measure and improve engagement and culture. Micron uses the 'Micron Voice' program to listen to team members, while AMD conducts an annual survey of its global workforce. AMD provides specific performance outcomes, reporting that its 2024 scores were among the best for global tech companies and ranked in the top 10% of peers, whereas Micron focuses on the methodology of its updated strategy encompassing culture, leadership, and inclusion without citing specific percentile rankings.

sentences.text: Listening to our team members is emphasized by the Micron Voice program.
In 2023, we updated our listening strategy - which encompasses engagement, culture, leadership behaviors, wellbeing and inclusion - and implemented a survey to learn more from our team members.
We conduct an annual survey of our global workforce to measure our culture, engagement, and workplace experience.

Our employees described our culture as inclusive, innovative, open, and respectful, and rated the quality of our managers high, and employment engagement is among the top 10% of our high-performing technology industry peers.

comparisons.peer_topic: Employee engagement survey performance and feedback mechanisms
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD values employee voice through an annual AMDer engagement survey, where the company ranks in the top 10% of high-tech firms, and supplements this with feedback on the employee lifecycle, benefits, and executive-led communication events like town halls.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies emphasize 'employee voice' and feedback mechanisms as central to their engagement strategies. Micron’s disclosure states that listening is emphasized through the Micron Voice program. AMD explicitly mentions valuing 'employee voice' through its annual AMDer Survey and supplements this with feedback on the employee lifecycle and executive-led town halls. Both use surveys as a primary tool for gauging employee sentiment.

comparisons.peer_topic: Talent Development and Employee Engagement Initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel invests in talent development through training programs, rotational assignments, updated job architecture, mentoring, and employee resource groups. Employee perceptions are gathered via annual surveys, and a portion of executive and employee performance bonuses is linked to improvements in employee experience survey results.
comparisons.comparison: Micron and Intel both rely on annual surveys to gather employee perceptions regarding their workplace experience. Micron implemented a survey as part of its updated listening strategy to learn more from team members. Intel utilizes an annual employee experience survey, employee inclusion survey, and manager development feedback survey to allow employees to voice perceptions. Intel distinguishes itself by linking a portion of performance bonuses to year-over-year improvements in these survey results, a specific incentive structure not mentioned in Micron's comparable disclosure.

sentences.text: In 2023, we updated our listening strategy - which encompasses engagement, culture, leadership behaviors, wellbeing and inclusion - and implemented a survey to learn more from our team members.

Through our annual employee experience survey, employee inclusion survey, and manager development feedback survey, employees can voice their perceptions of the company, their managers, their work experiences, and their learning and development opportunities.

Our employees' voices are important to enable our culture of continuous improvement, and as a result, we link a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to year-over-year improvements of our employee experience survey results.

comparisons.peer_topic: Employee sentiment and engagement measurement tools
comparisons.peer_summary: To evaluate employee sentiment and engagement, NVIDIA uses pulse surveys, an always-on interactive suggestion box, and an anonymous third-party platform that protects reporter identity and allows tracking of investigations.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies deploy specific survey and feedback tools to evaluate employee sentiment and engagement. Micron uses the 'Micron Voice' program and surveys as part of a research-based approach to understanding engagement. NVIDIA uses pulse surveys and an anonymous third-party platform to evaluate sentiment and engagement. While both use surveys, NVIDIA's disclosure details additional mechanisms like an 'always-on interactive suggestion box' and an anonymous platform for investigations, whereas Micron's disclosure focuses on the comprehensive scope of its updated listening strategy (engagement, culture, leadership, wellbeing, inclusion).
